mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger activates but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show y-o-y declines for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline y-o-y for 2 months
failure_condition: Interaction trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread flattens by > 50bps but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted unemployment rate - payroll employment diff (UNRATE - PAYEMS) spread signals labor market overheating that will lead the Fed to tighten policy and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Inverted UNRATE-PAYEMS spread trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth accelerating by > 3pp y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% signals a demand overheating scenario that will lead to inflation and Fed tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Overheating trigger activates but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: The S&P 500 will produce positive 5-day returns when the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is between 1-3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, as this signals a Goldilocks monetary regime of low inflation and easy policy.
failure_condition: Goldilocks trigger activates but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative > 45% of the time.
